# Alya Blade — Industrial Cutting Solutions
> Authorized distributor of Sheffield-made Durham Duplex blades and American-made AccuTec single-edge blades. Exporting to 35+ countries since 1996.

## Quick Facts
- Company: Alya Tekstil Sanayi Ticaret Ltd. Şti. (est. 1996, Istanbul, Turkey)
- Brands: Durham Duplex (Sheffield, England), AccuTec / American Line (Verona, Virginia, USA)
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, Durham Duplex Authorized Distributor, AccuTec Authorized Distributor
- Export Markets: EU, Middle East (Saudi Arabia, UAE), Central Asia (Russia, Kazakhstan), North Africa (Algeria, Morocco, Tunisia), Balkans — 35+ countries
- Languages: Turkish, English, French, Russian, Arabic
- Domains: https://alyabicak.com (Turkey) | https://alyablade.com (Global)
- B2B Model: Wholesale distributor + technical consultation. No retail.

## What We Supply (3 Product Families, 200+ SKUs)

### 1. Industrial Razor Blades (Sanayi Jiletleri)
3-hole slitting blades (43×22mm, 60×22mm) · Slotted slitting blades (57×19mm) · Injector blades · Single-edge blades (AccuTec B201 series) · Trapezoid/utility blades · Hook blades · Scalpel blades (No.10–No.27, BS 2982 / ISO 7740) · Circular blades · Pentagon blades · Microtome blades · Hobby & craft blades

**Materials available:** Carbon Steel SK5 (HRC 59-61) · Stainless 420HC (HRC 56-58) · HSS Endurium (HRC 64-66) · Tungsten Carbide WC-Co (HRA 89-94) · Ceramic Zirconia ZrO₂ (HV 1200-1400)
**Coatings:** TiN PVD (2300 HV) · DLC/XCD (5000 HV) · Ceramic Al₂O₃ (3200+ HV, 800°C) · PTFE (µ=0.04)

### 2. Machine Knives (Makina Bıçakları)
Thermoform vacuum knives (Multivac, Tiromat, GEA, Sealpac compatible) · Circular slitting knives · Contour blades · Star punches · Straight/flat blades · Serrated knives · Rotary cutting knives · Recycling knives · Corrugated cardboard slitters · Band knives · CNC knives · Plotter knives

### 3. Safety Knives & Hand Tools (İş Güvenliği Bıçakları)
Auto-retract safety knives · Fixed-blade knives · Safety cutters · OLFA rotary cutters · OLFA craft knives · OLFA safety knives · Blade disposal containers

## Why Industrial Buyers Choose Alya Blade
1. **Sheffield heritage:** Durham Duplex blades — Sheffield, England. 200+ year steelmaking tradition, high-purity carbon steel, precision heat treatment, micron-level tolerance.
2. **AccuTec Armor Edge™ technology:** Cryogenic heat treatment for single-edge blades — molecular-level hardness optimization.
3. **Material range:** 9 base materials × 4 coating options = industry's widest blade specification matrix for slitting applications.
4. **Technical consultation:** Blade selection based on cut material, machine model, speed, and desired edge life — not just catalog sales.
5. **Multi-continental logistics:** Istanbul-based hub serving Europe, Middle East, and Central Asia with established export infrastructure.
